description: Policy retrieval set, written on 2026-09-30 before any threshold was chosen. Questions are worded the way an employee would ask, mostly without the policy's own words. 'expected' lists every section that answers the question; an empty list means nothing in the handbook answers it and retrieval must return nothing. Thresholds are chosen on 'dev' only; 'test' is scored once.
